output.coverageDenominator: Declared component rows plus explicit omission rows; unknown additional items are not enumerable. No completeness percentage.
limitations: Source facts identify selected guide/BOM rows only; no actual school stock or assembled robot is established.
Component masses and placements are unknown; no origin, zero mass or homogeneous density substitutes are used.
Gearbox internals are not separately enumerated and must not be double-counted against the assembly.
The advertised nominal 31 lb product mass is not ingested as a numeric input: its weighed variant/scope is unresolved and it is not a complete robot mass.
Wheel material/durometer does not establish traction or friction. No aggregate mass, CoM or inertia is calculated.
Per-component masses/transforms are declarations with provenance, not authenticated assembly properties. V1 performs no aggregate physics, even if every declared row is filled.
